stem.text: The diagram shows a cathode-ray oscilloscope (c.r.o.) being used to measure the rate of rotation of a flywheel.

stem.alt: A flywheel with a small magnet M mounted on it, passing a coil whose two leads connect to a cathode-ray oscilloscope; the display is marked 10 cm wide

stem.text: The flywheel has a small magnet M mounted on it. Each time the magnet passes the coil, a voltage pulse is generated, which is passed to the c.r.o. The display of the c.r.o. is $10\,\text{cm}$ wide. The flywheel is rotating at $3000$ revolutions per minute.
Which time-base setting will display clearly separate pulses on the screen?
